grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is whole food or an allowed staple such as tinned chickpeas, tinned tomatoes and vegetable stock.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only one lidded pan, a knife and a board, and simple softening and simmering.

works.reason: 500g parsnips, two tins of chickpeas, a tin of tomatoes and 500ml stock make a well-balanced stew for four that will be tender in 25 minutes and is seasoned with spices and lemon.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes of active work covers chopping an onion, peeling 500g of parsnips and shredding kale, and the 35 cook minutes roughly match the 25 and 5 minute simmers plus the softening.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming spiced parsnip stew suits late November, and the 500g of parsnips are the backbone of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, in plain British English, and easy for a beginner to follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling bowl of vegetables, pulses and greens that a family would happily eat again.
